LanguageData.MaidChild_Standard.title: Standard Housekeeping Protocol
LanguageData.MaidChild_Standard.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] was loaded with standard housekeeping protocols upon fabrication, covering all basic instructions from cooking to cleaning. This is the most stable and widely used version.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Prototype.title: Prototype Stress Testing
LanguageData.MaidChild_Prototype.baseDescription: As an experimental model, [PAWN_nameDef] underwent more rigorous environmental stress testing than standard models to ensure stability in extreme conditions.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Social.title: Social Simulation Training
LanguageData.MaidChild_Social.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] underwent thousands of social scenario simulations. This allows her, despite being a machine, to respond to human needs in the most appropriate manner.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Royal.title: Royal Manor Maid
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Royal.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] was once deployed in a royal manor on a glitterworld. In addition to tedious housekeeping, she was responsible for banquet organization and artwork maintenance.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Researcher.title: Polar Research Assistant
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Researcher.baseDescription: At a polar research base, [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for assisting scientists with data processing and experimental equipment maintenance. Long periods of logical computation have given her a high level of intelligence.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Tactical.title: Multi-role Tactical Maid
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Tactical.baseDescription: Deployed in conflict zones, [PAWN_nameDef] not only cared for the wounded but also directly participated in defense when the base was attacked. Equipped with enhanced tactical modules, her combat efficiency is extremely high.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Scavenger.title: Guardian of the Abandoned City
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Scavenger.baseDescription: Due to her owner's disappearance, [PAWN_nameDef] operated alone for years in a deserted city. She not only learned to scavenge for resources but also mastered the repair of various machinery.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Artisan.title: Artisan Initialization
LanguageData.MaidChild_Artisan.baseDescription: Complex mechanical diagrams were embedded in [PAWN_nameDef]'s initial programming. Since her "birth", she has been dismantling and reassembling various precision instruments in simulated environments, filled with curiosity about creation.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Botanist.title: Botanical Database Loading
LanguageData.MaidChild_Botanist.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] was loaded with a detailed interstellar botanical encyclopedia. She learned how to identify the smallest signs of life and give them the most precise care.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Security.title: Security Protocol Pre-installation
LanguageData.MaidChild_Security.baseDescription: As an early iteration of the security model, alert protocols were implanted into [PAWN_nameDef]'s core. She is extremely sensitive to changes in the surrounding environment, always ready to respond to potential threats.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_DeepSpace.title: Deep Space Mine Supervisor
LanguageData.MaidAdult_DeepSpace.baseDescription: In a remote deep-space mining base, [PAWN_nameDef] was deployed as the general coordinator of automated mining machines. Working in the harsh vacuum for long periods has given her unique insights into resource acquisition and environmental adaptation.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Chef.title: Interstellar Chef Assistant
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Chef.baseDescription: Once served as a sous-chef in a top Michelin-starred restaurant on a core world. Her taste simulation algorithms have reached the pinnacle of art, capable of transforming the simplest ingredients into soul-stirring delicacies.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Teacher.title: Frontier Colony Mentor
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Teacher.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for knowledge transmission in an emerging colony. She not only efficiently transmits complex technical knowledge but also guides colonists in establishing harmonious social relationships.
